properties.NAME: Rapides County
properties.CHANGE: Rapides County created by Orleans Territory to "comprehend the settlements of Rapides, Avoyelles, Catahoula, Bayou Boeuf, Bayou Robert, and all other settlements which are now or may be in the vicinity thereof."
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1804, 1st Leg., 1st sess., ch. 25/p. 144-152; Calhoun, 72-80; Goins and Caldwell, 41)
